The TX-35-IW provides simple transmission of remote HDMI sources. Pair with the RX-35-POH for simple yet effective signal extension of 4K UHD content. The TX-35-IW uses standardized HDBaseT and PoH technology, meaning that it is compatible with many WyreStorm models including presentation receivers or the H2XC series of matrix switchers. The TX-35-IW is great for remote input applications including education environments such as training rooms or huddle spaces. It can be remotely powered from a compatible HDBaseT receiver and features IR and RS-232 control signal passthrough.
The TX-35-IW features PoH technology which allows it to be powered from a compatible HDBaseT receiver. Eliminate the need for bulky DC power supplies and remotely power the TX over category cable.

Using standard technologies such as HDBaseT and PoH makes the TX-35-IW compatible with a myriad of WyreStorm receivers such as the SW-515-RX, or even as a remote input into the MX-H2XC for larger deployments.
